name: Urea C 13

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypersensitivity Reactions: Hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis, have been reported in patients using IDkit Hp. summary: Warnings for this drug include reports of allergic reactions, including a severe and potentially life-threatening reaction called anaphylaxis, in patients using IDkit Hp [3]. The drug materials also note a warning related to phenylketonuria concerning the citric acid component in IDkit [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores of 9 for the liver and 7 for the heart [M].
